english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for sustained personal commitment to a job, cause, or activity.
Use this for devotion expressed as deep involvement in an activity, project, or cause rather than loyalty to a person.
Use this when involvement implies active commitment or personal investment, not just participation.
Use 投入 when commitment means wholehearted involvement in a course of action, job, or cause.

examples.english: I have a lot of dedication to this job.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 tau4 jap6

examples.english: Everyone shows great devotion to this charity event.
examples.traditional: 大家做呢個公益活動都好投入。
examples.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 zou6 ni1 go3 gung1 jik1 wut6 dung6 dou1 hou2 tau4 jap6

examples.english: Their deep involvement in the job means they still think about how to improve it after work.
examples.traditional: 佢對呢份工作好投入，放工都仲諗住點樣做好啲。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 deoi3 ne1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 tau4 jap6 fong3 gung1 dou1 zung6 nam2 zyu6 dim2 joeng2 zou6 hou2 di1

examples.english: I have a strong commitment to this job.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 tau4 jap6
